attribution: Behavioral observations from Gemini CLI, Copyright 2025 Google LLC, Apache-2.0; executable assertions remain in the pinned upstream test files.

observations.registry: Trusted project configuration and enabled extensions are registered; invalid definitions are skipped; hooks may be enabled by friendly name.
observations.planner: Tool-name regex matching has literal fallback; trigger matching is exact; identical name/command pairs deduplicate, preserving first entry.
observations.runner: Sequential hooks continue after failure; successful outputs modify the next input; malformed JSON is accepted as text and exit 0/1 maps to allow; exit 2 maps to deny; double-encoded JSON is accepted.

limitations: Mocked processes and collaborators, not operating-system confinement or effect recovery.
This fixture contains upstream expectations only; VCP contracts are deliberately separate.
